title: Ryze Mushroom Hot Cocoa Recipe
description: A warm, earthy cocoa made with Ryze Mushroom Cocoa Mix, your choice of milk and optional cinnamon or toppings.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: 2 tablespoons Ryze Mushroom Cocoa Mix (or the amount directed on the package)
1 cup of milk or plant-based milk: You can use any type of milk you prefer. Almond, coconut, oat, or regular dairy milk work well.
A pinch of cinnamon (optional): For an added touch of warmth and spice.
Whipped cream or marshmallows (optional): For topping if you’re feeling a little indulgent.
instructions:
1. Heat the Milk: In a small saucepan, heat the milk over medium heat until it’s warm but not boiling.
  2. Mix the Cocoa: Add the 2 tablespoons of Ryze Mushroom Cocoa Mix to the warm milk. Stir constantly to ensure that the cocoa mixes well and no lumps remain.
  3. Add Sweetener: If you like your hot cocoa a bit sweeter, add your choice of sweetener to taste. Stir well until fully incorporated.
  4. Simmer: Let the mixture simmer for about a minute, stirring frequently, to let the flavors meld together.
  5. Add Spices: If using, sprinkle in a pinch of cinnamon to enhance the flavor.
  6. Serve: Pour the hot cocoa into your favorite mug.
  7. Garnish: Top with whipped cream or marshmallows if desired, and perhaps an extra sprinkle of cinnamon or cocoa powder for decoration.
notes:
• Milk Temperature: Do not boil the milk. Overheating can cause it to form a skin on the top and may alter the taste. Aim for a gentle heat to make the cocoa mix dissolve properly.
  • Consistent Stirring: Keep stirring the mixture as you add the cocoa mix. This will help avoid any lumps and ensure that the cocoa is evenly distributed throughout the milk.
  • Customize Your Cup: Feel free to experiment with different types of milk until you find one that suits your taste best. Each type of milk can give your cocoa a slightly different flavor profile and creaminess.
  • Flavor variations: Add a little turmeric for warm spice, or an espresso shot for coffee flavor.
